subject: Staggered renewal credit split and co-term options — Hearthly Labs
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@hearthly.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@hearthly.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Staggered renewal credit split — options and timeline

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Hearthly is planning a mid-contract expansion and we wanted to surface a few constraints from procurement before we move to a formal quote. High level: we expect to add ~50 new seats (net-new usage) as of Sept 1, but cashflow is constrained and procurement prefers to spread the additional spend across Q3/Q4 rather than a big uplift in July.

Questions:
- Would Redwood consider a staggered uplift credit (apply $X credit against Jul–Sep, then remaining credit Oct–Dec) rather than a single up-front credit?
- Can we co-term the new uplift to Dec 31, 2026 to align with our fiscal year?
- Any flexibility on onboarding credits or CS hours tied to the expansion?

Procurement attached our renewal requirements doc (Hearthly_renewal_requirements.pdf). Our goal is to get to an MSA + amendment signed by Aug 5 to hit internal budgeting. If there are multiple paths (one-time larger credit vs staged smaller credits + extended term), please outline both.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 30m call if easier.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Platform
Hearthly Labs
attachments: Hearthly_renewal_requirements.pdf

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@hearthly.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered renewal credit split — options and timeline

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the doc. Looping in Ben and Monica from Commercial and Aditya on strategy so we can present a few concrete options.

Quick summary of options we can do today (high level):

Option A — One-time uplift credit (simple):
- $40,000 one-time credit applied against July invoice to offset immediate uplift.
- Co-term to 2026-12-31 available.
- Onboarding credit: 12 hours of prioritized CS support (value estimated $12k), one-time.

Option B — Staggered credit (preferred by procurement):
- $20,000 credit applied Jul–Sep (applied as $6,667/mo) and $20,000 applied Oct–Dec (same split) — total $40k.
- Co-term to 2026-12-31.
- Onboarding credit: 8 hours (value $8k) or can be exchanged for 2 months of priority onboarding at reduced rate.

Option C — Annualize + discount ladder (if Hearthly annualizes the added seats into a 12-mo commit):
- 10% additional discount band on the uplifted units if commit > $500k ARR.
- Increase onboarding credit to $15k.

Practical notes:
- We can implement staggered billing via amendment; it requires PO + signature and a short SOW for CS hours.
- Legal turnaround for amendment/DocuSign typically 48–72 hours once commercial terms are agreed.

I attached a proposed-staggered-quote.xlsx with numbers and two paths (one-time vs staged) so procurement can forward to finance. Next steps: if you confirm preferred option, Ben will finalize pricing and Monica will scope CS hours and SOW.

If helpful, we can do a 30-minute pricing alignment on Thu.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed-staggered-quote.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@hearthly.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered renewal credit split — options and timeline

Thanks, Jasmine — quick note from Commercial: if Hearthly is willing to annualize the uplift (move the 50 seats into an annual add-on), we can open an extra discount band (up to 12%) and increase onboarding credit to $12k. If they want to keep the staggered cashflow without annualizing, the $40k staged credit + 8 hours CS is the cleanest path.

I'm happy to join procurement call and will ping Legal to prep a DocuSign amendment template once Sarah confirms the route.

—Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Kim <sarah@hearthly.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@hearthly.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered renewal credit split — options and timeline

Thanks Jasmine & Ben — procurement reviewed the attachments and we have a counter:

Counter-proposal (procurement):
- We can accept a $35,000 total credit if Redwood will front-load 60% of that credit Jul–Aug and the remaining 40% Oct–Dec. Procurement prefers earlier relief to hit internal burn targets.
- Onboarding credit: $8k (we can stretch to $10k only if Redwood shortens amendment turnaround to <48 hours after final terms).
- We confirm the 50-seat net-new add, effective Sept 1, billed pro-rata for Sept and then monthly.
- Co-term to 2026-12-31 is acceptable.

Procurement has attached a draft PO and timeline (Hearthly_PO_draft.docx). Our target is to have signed amendment + PO by Aug 5. If we can get DocuSign this week for a narrow set of commercial terms, procurement will expedite.

On the call: if Redwood can do the faster legal turnaround and agree to the 60/40 front-load, we are ready to move.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Platform, Hearthly Labs
attachments: Hearthly_PO_draft.docx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal — Exec concession guidance for Hearthly Labs (HL-2026-089)

Internal only — not for external distribution.

Per the thread and procurement timeline: exec approves concession up to $10k onboarding credit if Hearthly signs by Aug 5 and accepts the 60/40 front-loaded credit profile. We can flex total credit down to $35k (from $40k) to accelerate approval. If they annualize the uplift and commit > $500k ARR, authorize an additional 8–10% discount band on uplift units.

Ben — please incorporate this guidance into the final amendment. Monica — please have a short SOW template ready that ties the onboarding credit to deliverables (2 weeks prioritized onboarding + 2 check-in sessions). Legal — please prioritize the amendment for DocuSign once commercial is confirmed.

—Aditya
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
